# Law Content & Maintenance Skill

1. Search canonical knowledge before adding legal concepts.
2. Verify applicable law/version/date before changing statutory content.
3. Reuse stable topic IDs and routes.
4. Keep notes structured like textbook chapters.
5. Separate statutory text, explanation, examples, case law, and exam guidance.
6. Never fabricate judgments, citations, sections, or legal propositions.
7. Update README/docs when supported subjects or workflows change.
8. Do not run production builds for documentation-only, README-only, or .github-only changes.
9. For source changes, run lint and production build.

Completion: canonical knowledge reused, law/version checked, no duplicated legal records, complete student explanation, routes preserved, docs updated, source checks clean.
